stories.deck: Severe Cyclone Akvan crossed the North Andhra Pradesh–South Odisha coast near Gopalpur at 07:30–08:30 IST on Friday, winds 70–80 kmph gusting to 90. More than 300,000 people were evacuated in Odisha and 423 rescue teams deployed.
stories.headline: Akvan comes ashore in India

stories.deck: COP31 enters its scheduled closing day in Antalya with no deal yet. Thursday's slimmed-down draft — cut from 144 paragraphs to 80 — removed every reference to fossil fuels, and the proposed $120bn-a-year adaptation finance target for 2035 stays unresolved.
stories.headline: COP31 reaches its final day

stories.deck: The biggest IPO ever — $81.3bn raised at $83 a share — opened at $111.50 and closed up 17% at $97.17. But the Dow fell 1,101 points on Thursday, and Asia opened lower on Friday.
stories.headline: Anthropic ends first day up 17%

stories.deck: Trump, Xi and Putin met for 80 minutes in Shenzhen on Thursday and issued a four-point declaration on the UN, oil, state immunity and nuclear risk — silent on Ukraine and Iran. Trump rates it '12 out of 10'.
stories.headline: Leaders issue joint declaration

stories.deck: European leaders in Berlin say they are ready to negotiate with Russia on ending the war — but only with Europe and Kyiv at the table. Merz says talks 'will take place soon', possibly in the UAE; Putin rejects a European role.
stories.headline: Europe ready for Ukraine talks

stories.deck: Daytime Russian strikes on Kyiv on Thursday killed a 26-year-old man and injured five. The Dutch and Austrian embassies were damaged and windows shattered at St Volodymyr's Cathedral; it is not confirmed the embassies were targeted.
stories.headline: Strikes hit Kyiv embassies

stories.deck: The Senate voted 51–48 on Thursday to defeat a House-passed resolution directing Trump to end the war in Iran or seek Congress' approval. Three Republicans voted in favour; Fetterman was the only Democrat against.
stories.headline: Senate rejects Iran war-powers bid

stories.deck: California has opened an inquiry into Nvidia over its chips and China, days after Jensen Huang's departure from the spotlight. Details of the probe's scope remain limited.
stories.headline: State probes Nvidia over China chips
stories.source: Bloomberg via ASX live blog, 20 Nov 2026 (per research-notes §5, second-hand)

stories.deck: Glenn Phillips made 118 and Henry Nicholls was 146 not out at lunch on day two as New Zealand reached 317–6 against India at the Basin Reserve. Phillips is the first batter to score Test, ODI and T20I hundreds against India in one year.
stories.headline: Phillips makes history with 118

stories.deck: Sensor Tower estimates 19.1 million copies and about $1.84bn by Thursday morning, mostly pre-orders — more than double GTA V's first day; it later raised the estimate to 24.6m copies and $2.36bn. Take-Two has not confirmed the figures. Metacritic 99.
stories.headline: GTA VI's first full day on sale

stories.deck: A boat carrying 50–100 migrants capsized off Yenne, south of Dakar, at about 02:00 on Wednesday. Four bodies have been recovered and dozens are missing; search operations resumed on Thursday.
stories.headline: Migrant boat sinks off Senegal

stories.deck: Tonga declared a nationwide state of emergency on Thursday over El Niño drought, after months of dry conditions. Schools will end the academic year early, closing on Friday; water supplies, farming and livestock are under strain.
stories.headline: Drought emergency in Tonga

stories.deck: Trump announced a posthumous pardon on Thursday for Pete Rose, baseball's all-time hits leader (4,256), who died in 2024. The pardon covers his tax convictions; his Hall of Fame ineligibility had already been lifted in May 2025, with the next vote in December 2027.
stories.headline: Trump pardons Pete Rose

stories.deck: Fiona, the Cincinnati Zoo's internet-famous hippo, died on Thursday aged 9 after ingesting a knit hat that fell into her enclosure on 8 November. Vets tried for days to help her pass it; surgery was not an option for an adult hippo.
stories.headline: Fiona the hippo dies at the zoo

stories.deck: Five aid groups scored the 20-point Gaza peace plan 4 out of 26 one year on, down from 5 in April. Humanitarian access scores zero; 1,650 people have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire and only 49 aid trucks a day entered in September, against 600 required.
stories.headline: Aid groups score the peace plan 4 out of 26

stories.deck: The court ruled 9–6 on Thursday that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in 2017 — the first state ever so convicted — and ordered reparations. Guterres welcomed the ruling; The Gambia, which brought the case, called it historic.
stories.headline: The world absorbs the genocide verdict

stories.deck: Pentagon budget official Arthur Miller told the Senate on Thursday the war has cost $48.3bn as of 13 November — munitions, equipment replacement and operations. The figure excludes damage to US bases, which lawmakers are demanding.
stories.headline: The US war against Iran has cost $48.3bn

stories.deck: Britain and Norway will jointly fund more than £100m for two UK-built 30-metre fast attack boats for Ukraine, split equally through the Maritime Capability Coalition. No delivery date has been announced.
stories.headline: UK and Norway fund £100m-plus for two Ukrainian naval craft

stories.deck: Aleksandar Cupic, a university lecturer from the student-led movement, was elected Speaker of Serbia's National Assembly on Thursday, 140–97. As speaker he also becomes acting president after Vucic's resignation.
stories.headline: Cupic is elected speaker of Serbia's new parliament

stories.deck: Denmark's parliament approved the US–Denmark–Greenland security deal on Thursday, 109–0, the final parliamentary step toward more US bases in Greenland. The deal, signed in September, takes effect once Denmark formally notifies the US.
stories.headline: Denmark approves Greenland security deal

stories.deck: Indonesia's parliament passed the asset-forfeiture bill into law on Thursday after 18 years of debate. Authorities can now seize assets linked to corruption and other crimes in some cases without a conviction, for assets worth at least Rp 1bn.
stories.headline: Indonesia passes asset-forfeiture bill

stories.deck: Neptune missiles hit the railway span overnight into Thursday — the third strike in four days — halting trains; some service resumed by the afternoon. Free ferries start across the strait on Friday.
stories.headline: Bridge attack halts Crimea rail a third time

stories.deck: Tanaiste Simon Harris said Dublin–London talks on the criteria for a border poll would be 'useful', after Northern Ireland Secretary Chris Bryant said on Thursday he would call one only when it 'appears likely' a majority wants unity.
stories.headline: Harris seeks border-poll criteria talks

stories.deck: A Florida judge ruled on Thursday that Thomas Markle Sr, 82, is competent to stand trial on a charge of possessing child sexual abuse material. The psychiatrist also found he was exaggerating memory loss; the next hearing is 1 December.
stories.headline: Thomas Markle is found fit to stand trial

stories.deck: Core prices rose 2.2% in October from a year earlier, data showed on Friday, above the Bank of Japan's 2% target for a second month — cementing expectations of a rate rise to 1.5% on 18 December.
stories.headline: Japan's core inflation rises to 2.2%

stories.deck: South African producer DJ Lag told the BBC it was 'a dream come true' that his track 'Shay'sana' (with Robot Boii ft Kamo Mphela) is on GTA VI's AfroBank FM station. The track was revealed in Rockstar's radio preview in October; the interview came at launch.
stories.headline: DJ Lag celebrates featuring on GTA 6

stories.deck: The Nikkei 225 closed on Thursday at 59,444.21, up 419.93 points or 0.71%, led by AI and semiconductor shares; the broader TOPIX slipped 0.04%. Tokyo fell sharply on Friday morning as the global selloff spread.
stories.headline: Nikkei rose 0.71% Thursday

stories.deck: Australia's unemployment rate rose to 4.9% in October, the highest since October 2021, as employment fell by 43,500. The ASX 200 fell 1.04% on Thursday and futures were down about 1.1% before Friday's open.
stories.headline: ASX futures fall; jobless rate rises to 4.9%

stories.deck: Indian benchmarks opened lower on Friday on the global selloff: the Sensex opened at 82,558.25, down 0.55%, and the Nifty at 25,368, down 0.57%, from Thursday's closes of 83,021.75 and 25,514.30.
stories.headline: Sensex slips at Friday's open

stories.deck: The COP31 draft says full implementation of current national climate plans would put the world on course for about 2.6°C of warming. It puts developing countries' adaptation needs at about $305bn a year by 2035.
stories.headline: Current pledges point to about 2.6°C of warming
stories.source: COP31 presidency draft, 16 Nov 2026, via TBS / AsiaToday

stories.deck: Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik leads Pakistan's delegation to the first SCO Civilisational Dialogue in New Delhi, 20–22 November — the first Pakistani ministerial visit to India since May 2023.
stories.headline: A Pakistan minister will lead a delegation to Delhi

stories.deck: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said in Shenzhen on Thursday that Japan intends to build a 'constructive and stable' relationship with China and keep dialogue going. She had only a handshake with Xi, with no formal bilateral meeting.
stories.headline: PM Takaichi seeks continued dialogue with China

stories.deck: Australia imposed targeted sanctions on Wednesday on three individuals and four organisations over West Bank settlement expansion, including settler leader Daniella Weiss — the first time a settlement construction company has been targeted.
stories.headline: Australia sanctions West Bank settler groups

stories.deck: The Liberian-flagged LPG carrier Gas Husky sank about 50 miles east of Byala on Tuesday after being hit by four projectiles, officials said; all 19 Filipino crew were rescued. Bulgaria's Defence Ministry has not confirmed the cause.
stories.headline: An LPG tanker sunk off Bulgaria was hit by projectiles

stories.deck: The Trump administration asked the Supreme Court on Wednesday — its third trip to the Court on this fight — to keep TPS termination for hundreds of thousands of Venezuelans in place. The lower court's ruling restoring TPS takes effect on Friday unless a court intervenes.
stories.headline: US files emergency Supreme Court request over Venezuelan TPS

stories.deck: Agriculture minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan dedicates India's first home-grown H5N1 vaccine for chickens in Bhopal on Friday. One dose is expected to protect birds for six months; no commercial vaccine existed for this strain.
stories.headline: India dedicates its first home-grown bird-flu vaccine

layout.date_check: First reported Thursday 19 Nov, so NOT on this page as news: the Trump–Xi–Putin trilateral itself · Anthropic's $83 IPO pricing · GTA VI's midnight unlock · the ICJ's Rohingya genocide judgment · the Van Gogh record $190.4m sale (18 Nov) · the EU's proposed €45bn loan for Ukraine · the US–Venezuela military deal · Fiji's drought declaration · Han Duck-soo's retrial order — not an acquittal · the Crimean Bridge attack · the Houthi strike on Riyadh's PIF tower.
layout.footer: Where an event began earlier in the week, the Friday development is the story. Disputed claims are attributed, not stated as fact. Sources: Reuters, AP, BBC, The Hindu, IMD, ICC, ReliefWeb, PINA. Original drawings.

meta.note: Headlines/decks in layout are condensations of the verified JSON decks for fit; no figure, date or name was changed. Card headlines 18/19/35 shortened (detail kept in deck/brief).
